noAccess.title: You do not have access to this page
noAccess.body: Your platform role does not include this area. Ask a Super Admin if you need it.

roleHints.PLATFORM_ADMIN: Everything: tenants, plans, money, settings and staff.
roleHints.PLATFORM_SUPPORT: Read tenants, sign in as support and publish announcements. No money.
roleHints.PLATFORM_FINANCE: Plans (read), invoices, payments and dashboards. No plan editing.

features.title: Features
features.hint: Each module follows the plan unless you override it for this tenant. "Plan" removes the override.

form.wholeNumber: Enter a whole number of 0 or more
form.amount: Enter an amount of 0 or more

dashboard.title: Platform dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Revenue, subscriptions and usage across every certification body on iCASCO.
dashboard.noRenewals: No renewals in the next 30 days
dashboard.noCandidates: No tenant is close to its limits

reasons.USERS_AND_CERTIFICATES_NEAR_LIMIT: Users and certificates at 80 % of the plan or more
reasons.USERS_NEAR_LIMIT: Users at 80 % of the plan or more
reasons.CERTIFICATES_NEAR_LIMIT: Active certificates at 80 % of the cap or more

tenants.title: Tenants
tenants.subtitle: Certification bodies subscribed to iCASCO, with their plan, status and usage.

tenantCreate.title: New tenant
tenantCreate.subtitle: Creates the certification body, its subscription and the first CAB admin, who receives an invitation email.
tenantCreate.adminHint: This person gets an email to set a password and finish the CAB setup.
tenantCreate.trialDaysHint: Trial of {{count}} day; billing starts when it ends.
tenantCreate.trialDaysHint_other: Trial of {{count}} days; billing starts when it ends.
tenantCreate.created: Tenant created. An invitation was sent to {{email}}.

tenant.deletionReady: The read-only period has ended. The tenant's data can now be deleted permanently.
tenant.deletionWaiting: Data stays read-only until {{date}}; permanent deletion is possible after that.
tenant.deleteBody: All of the tenant's data is removed and cannot be recovered.
tenant.statusActionsHint: Every change needs a reason and is kept in the audit log.

confirmBody.activate: The subscription becomes active and billing starts.
confirmBody.suspend: The CAB workspace becomes read-only until it is reactivated.
confirmBody.reactivate: The CAB gets full access again.
confirmBody.cancel: The workspace stays read-only for the quarantine period, then the data is due for deletion.

tenant.confirmChangeBody: The change applies immediately and is recorded in the audit log.

impersonate.title: Open {{name}} as support
impersonate.description: The CAB workspace opens in a new tab with a banner telling its users that iCASCO support is signed in. The session is logged.
impersonate.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Help with the certificate template (ticket #482)
impersonate.reasonHint: Shown to the CAB in the banner. At least 5 characters.
impersonate.opened: The workspace of {{name}} opened in a new tab
impersonate.popupBlocked: The browser blocked the new tab. Allow pop-ups for iCASCO and try again.

plans.title: Plans
plans.subtitle: Prices, limits and modules of each plan. Changes apply to every tenant on the plan.
plans.name: Name
plans.codeRule: 2 to 30 capital letters, digits or _ (e.g. PROFESSIONAL)
plans.codeLocked: The code cannot be changed after creation.
plans.pricingHint: Invoices also show the SAR equivalent and VAT from the platform settings.
plans.coreNote: CAB profile, audit clients, applications, account and notifications are always included.
plans.archiveBody: Archived plans cannot be chosen for new tenants. Existing tenants keep it until you move them.
plans.archiveForceTitle: Tenants are still on this plan
plans.archiveForceBody: {{count}} tenants use this plan. Archive it anyway? They keep their subscription.

invoices.title: Invoices & payments
invoices.subtitle: iCASCO subscription invoices: generate, issue, record bank transfers and export.
invoices.nothingToGenerate: No invoice is due right now
invoices.issueBody: The tenant sees it in My subscription and the due date starts counting.
invoices.voidBody: The invoice stays on record as void and no longer counts as owed.

payment.title: Record payment: {{number}}
payment.description: Open amount: {{amount}}. A full payment marks the invoice paid and reactivates a past-due subscription.
payment.manualNote: Collection is manual (bank transfer). No card gateway is connected yet.

announcements.title: Announcements
announcements.subtitle: Messages shown as a banner in CAB workspaces: to everyone, one plan or one tenant.
announcements.endAfterStart: The end must be after the start

staff.title: Platform staff
staff.subtitle: iCASCO team members who can open this console, and what each role may do.
staff.inviteBody: They receive an email to set a password.
staff.name: Name
staff.deactivateBody: They can no longer sign in to the console.
staff.reactivateBody: They can sign in again with their current role.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Every change made in the platform console, with who, when and why.

settings.title: Platform settings
settings.subtitle: Rates and lifecycle rules used for every tenant.
settings.sarRateHint: Used for the SAR equivalent on invoices.
settings.trialDaysHint: Proposed when a tenant is created with a trial.
settings.graceDaysHint: Days after the due date before a past-due tenant is suspended.
settings.quarantineMonthsHint: After cancellation or expiry, data stays read-only this long, then is due for deletion.
settings.paymentTermsHint: Days between issuing an invoice and its due date.
settings.trialPlanHint: Plan given to certification bodies that sign up for a trial.

subscription.lockedTileAria: {{name}}: not in your plan. Open My subscription

errors.FEATURE_NOT_IN_PLAN: This feature is not included in your plan. Open My subscription to upgrade.
errors.SUBSCRIPTION_READ_ONLY: Your subscription is read-only, so changes cannot be saved. Open My subscription for details.
errors.USER_LIMIT_REACHED: You have reached the number of users in your plan. Open My subscription to add users or upgrade.
errors.CERTIFICATE_LIMIT_REACHED: You have reached the active certificate limit of your plan. Open My subscription to upgrade.

banners.impersonation: Signed in by iCASCO support to {{name}}

readOnlyBody.SUSPENDED: Your subscription is suspended; you can view your data but not change it until it is reactivated.
readOnlyBody.CANCELLED: Your subscription has ended; your data stays available to view for a limited time.
readOnlyBody.EXPIRED: Your subscription has expired; your data stays available to view for a limited time.
readOnlyBody.default: Changes cannot be saved right now.

locked.title: {{feature}} is not included in your plan
locked.body: Your {{plan}} plan does not include {{feature}}. Request an upgrade and the iCASCO team will contact you.

upgrade.title: Request an upgrade
upgrade.description: Tell us what you need. The iCASCO team is notified and will get back to you.
upgrade.messagePlaceholder: e.g. We need certification cycles and 5 more users from next month.
upgrade.sent: Request sent. The iCASCO team will contact you.

page.title: My subscription
page.subtitle: Your iCASCO plan, what it includes, how much of it you use and your invoices.
page.loadError: Your subscription could not be loaded.
page.usersWarning: You are close to your user limit.
page.certificatesWarning: You have used 80 % or more of your active certificate cap. Above the cap an upgrade is required to issue new certificates.
page.coreAlways: CAB profile, audit clients, applications, account and notifications are part of every plan.
page.endedBody: The read-only period is over. Contact iCASCO to renew your subscription and restore access to your data.
page.everythingIncluded: Every module is included in your plan.
page.paymentNote: Pay by bank transfer quoting the invoice number. Amounts are in USD; the SAR equivalent and 15 % VAT are shown on each invoice.

tour.title: My subscription
tour.body: Your plan, renewal date, usage against your limits, included modules and iCASCO invoices. Request an upgrade from here.

impersonationStart.failedBody: Start the support session again from the iCASCO platform console.
